title: John Lennon’s Bag One exhibition opens in San Francisco | 1970
content:
Bag One, John Lennon’s exhibition of erotic lithographs, opened on 13 February 1970 at the Cory Galleries in San Francisco, California, USA.

The lithographs, known collectively as Bag One, had been drawn by Lennon in 1969, and chronicled his wedding ceremony and honeymoon with Yoko Ono, and one of their bed-ins for world peace.

The Bag One Portfolio was published as a limited edition of 300, and contained 14 artworks. Similar exhibitions had opened in London (15 January), Detroit (21 January), Long Beach (28 January), New York City (7 February), and Amsterdam (7 February).

The Cory Galleries were at 360 Geary Street and 377 Jefferson Street in San Francisco.
